context: A boss reads policy headlines with his manager
purpose: Teach: 分権/入札/海軍/排出/大気/中略/省略/ビザ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今朝の一面は地方分権の見直しか。また同じ議論の繰り返しだな。
lines.en: Front page is decentralization reform again. Same debate as always.
lines.style: Gruff boss reading newspaper aloud at his desk, mildly exasperated tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 次の段落、公共事業の入札制度に不正があったと書いてあります。
lines.en: The next paragraph says there was misconduct in the public bidding system.
lines.style: Calm manager reporting facts neutrally, professional reading voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: またか。米海軍との合同訓練の記事はどこだ。あれが気になる。
lines.en: Again? Where's the article on joint drills with the US Navy? I'm curious.
lines.style: Impatient older boss flipping pages, slightly louder and demanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 三面です。あと工場の排出ガス規制が強化されるそうですよ。
lines.en: Page three. Also, factory emissions regulations will be tightened apparently.
lines.style: Polite subordinate redirecting boss's attention, even measured pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 排出か。うちの取引先にも影響が出るな。大気汚染の数値も載ってるか?
lines.en: Emissions, huh. Our suppliers will feel it. Are the air pollution numbers listed?
lines.style: Thoughtful boss connecting news to business, slower contemplative delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、グラフ付きで。長いので中略しますが、東京は基準値を超えています。
lines.en: Yes, with a graph. I'll skip the middle, but Tokyo exceeds the threshold.
lines.style: Efficient manager summarizing concisely, professional briefing tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 細かい数字は省略でいい。最後、外国人労働者のビザ緩和の件は?
lines.en: Skip the fine numbers. Last thing — what about the foreign worker visa easing?
lines.style: Decisive boss cutting to what matters, brisk and authoritative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 来月から審査基準が変わるそうです。詳細は午後の会議で共有します。
lines.en: Screening criteria change next month. I'll share details at the afternoon meeting.
lines.style: Composed manager wrapping up briefing, reassuring professional close.
